description.en:
In the context of distance relations, the line between the source point and the actor point—defined by the coordinates (xs, ys) and (xd, yd), respectively—has a certain length, denoted as r.

description.en:
"Default of actor type" refers to the default method by which the actor's type processes incoming raw damage.
"Apply to this setting only" means that incoming damage bypasses the actor's default processing and directly applies the configurations specified here.
"Higher priority than default" means that the configurations specified here are applied to the incoming damage first, followed by the actor's default processing.
"Lower priority than default" means that incoming damage is first processed by the actor default, and then modified by the configurations specified here.
description.zh:
「角色預設」是指該角色的角色類型對於所受原始傷害的預設處理方式。
「僅套用此處設定」是指對於受到的傷害不進行預設的處理，而是直接套用此處的設定。
「優先於角色預設」是指先套用此處的設定，再進行預設的處理。
「落後於角色預設」是指先進行預設的處理，再套用此處的設定。

description.en:
In the context of distance relations, the line between the source point and the actor point—defined by the coordinates (xs, ys) and (xd, yd), respectively—has a certain length, denoted as r. Additionally, bnd represents the length of the line segment extending from the source point in the direction of the actor point, up to the boundary of the range.
The last relationship whose "Distance" is greater than or equal to "r" and the two values are closest will be applied.
description.zh:
在距離關係式中，可以 (xs, ys) 表示「基準點的座標」；以 (xd, yd) 表示「角色的位置」；以「r」表示「基準點與角色位置之間的線段長度」；以「bnd」表示「基準點往角色方向延伸至範圍邊界的線段長度」。
此項會套用設定中的「距離」大於或等於「r」且兩者數值最接近的最後一個關係式。
